Based on the provided text, the VaxiQuick vaccine demonstrates 70% efficacy in preventing mild cases and 85% efficacy in preventing severe cases across all adult age groups. However, its ability to prevent transmission to unvaccinated individuals has not been thoroughly studied. The text does not provide specific data regarding suitability for children, the elderly, or individuals with specific health conditions beyond the general "all adult age groups" statement.
